newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 20 to 22 bln Ffr of OATs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 20 to 22 bln Ffr of OATs Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 20 and 22 billion francs of government bonds (OATs) at its next scheduled auction on June 5, the Treasury said on Tuesday.

The Treasury will offer the current 10-year benchmark OAT, the 5.50 percent April 25, 2007 OAT. It will also offer the 8.50 percent October 25, 2008 OAT and the Janary 25, 2009 TEC 10 variable rate OAT.
All three bonds have a payment date of June 26, the statement said.

While the amount issued was slightly below expectations the lines on offer were in line with traders' predictions. Traders said earlier a new 10-year benchmark OAT would probably be issued at next month's auction.
